thread.title: Girls und Panzer - Operation: More Love Love! • Girls und Panzer: Motto Love Love Sakusen Desu! - Episode 5 discussion

opinions.point: Several commenters found the episode highly entertaining and praised its absurd comedy.
Commenters enjoyed the focus on side characters, especially the mothers, university students, and Erika.
The character interactions and playful dynamics were repeatedly viewed as a strength.
One commenter liked the comedy and slice-of-life direction but wished the franchise had included this material more consistently and retained more tank action.
A commenter criticized the Russian-language performance, particularly the accent and phrasing.
One reaction described the opening segment as surprisingly effective horror-comedy.
